front.title: A YANG Data Model for BGP-LS Segment Routing Policy

abstract.t: This document defines a YANG data model for the operational state of Segment Routing (SR) Policy candidate paths that are advertised using BGP - Link State (BGP-LS). The model augments the read-only BGP-LS Link-State Database with the SR Policy Candidate Path Network Layer Reachability Information (NLRI) and the associated BGP-LS Attribute TLVs specified in RFC 9857.
